headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 sucrotherm was down *4+ hours* on cascading kettle valve gasket failures — gasket pieces recovered but system still draining.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 sucrotherm out from 06:48 with cascading gasket failures on both kettle return valves — still draining to recover gasket fragments as of window close. Sollich 3 ran but had extensive post-cleaning assembly issues including missing bolts, damaged C20 belt, and ongoing MM3 indexer problems. Sollich 4 ran clean.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 demolder mold clamps failed at 08:32, replaced and running by 08:42. Film printer issues at 10:15 — some rolls missing batch codes or open — under inspection. ML2 and FFS ran without issues.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 depositor 1 riser pump faulting from 05:56, tempering achieved by 10:53 but pump issue unresolved. Truffle line M4 belt alarm at 11:04, maintenance checking. ML1 had C2 belt break at 09:30, cleared by 10:27. MF Matrix ran clean.

resolved.title: ML3 demolder mold clamps failing, molds dropping after demold
resolved.summary: Both clamps not holding molds in place on demolder plate, causing molds to fall out after demolding.
resolved.resolution: Both clamps replaced on demolder plate by 08:42 — "Line is back up" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML1 C2 belt moved south and broke
resolved.summary: C2 belt tracking failure caused southward shift and belt break.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:27 — "C2 belt is good to go now" (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 sucrotherm down on cascading kettle return valve gasket failures
needs_attention.summary: Sucrotherm failed at 06:48; both kettle B and kettle A return valve gaskets found broken and incomplete, requiring replacement and system drain to recover fragments.
needs_attention.status: Gasket pieces found in filter at 11:28. System still draining caramel, will wash and restart cooking.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 multiple post-cleaning assembly defects and equipment issues
needs_attention.summary: C20 belt damaged from missing bolt on nose bar roller, multiple scrapers and covers not installed after cleaning, MM3 indexer and heating element cables improperly configured.
needs_attention.status: MM3, 4, and 5 operational as of 10:04, but MM3 indexer and heating element cable issues flagged at 11:14 — maintenance tightening.

needs_attention.title: ML3 film printer producing rolls without batch codes or open seals
needs_attention.summary: Some film rolls missing printed batch code, others coming out open; printer inspection requested.
needs_attention.status: Five affected boxes removed and inspected; product passed water test and specs. Printer inspection ongoing as of 10:19.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 riser pump faulting in temper mode
needs_attention.summary: Riser pump shuts off when placed in temper mode; works in reheat mode, suggesting incorrect pump setting or pipe blockage.
needs_attention.status: Jakob adjusted pump setting and valve, reheat completed, temper achieved at 10:53, but pump issue unresolved — suspected pipe buildup.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M4 belt alarm triggered
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt alarm going off, maintenance called to check M3 and M4.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance checking M3 and M4 as of 11:09.
